blurb: Adams County Winery is located on 70 acres of rolling Pennsylvania hills with a tasting room in a historic 1860s bank barn. Guests can enjoy wine tastings, live music events, and seasonal celebrations. The winery offers a variety of wines including sweet reds, dry whites, and fruit wines, and also hosts timed 5K runs and live music performances on the grounds.
